# Ustaad — Private Tutors UAE
# https://ustaad.ae

## About
Ustaad is a UAE-based private tutoring service providing expert 1-to-1 academic support to students across Dubai, Abu Dhabi, Sharjah, Ajman, Al Ain, Ras Al Khaimah, and Fujairah. Founded in 2015, Ustaad has supported over 2,500 students across all major curricula.

## Services
- Private 1-to-1 tutoring for IGCSE, GCSE, A-Level, IB (MYP, DP SL/HL), and American Curriculum (AP, SAT)
- Subject expertise: Mathematics, Physics, Chemistry, Biology, English, Economics, Business Studies, Accounting, Finance, Statistics, Engineering
- Exam preparation: Past paper practice, mark scheme training, exam technique
- Curriculum-aligned teaching: Cambridge, Edexcel, AQA, IB, College Board
- Free homework question service: written solution in 15 minutes via WhatsApp
